field.name: intermediate_steel_area_m2

label.en: Intermediate longitudinal steel area A_s,int (0 = none)
label.de: Fläche der mittleren Längsbewehrung A_s,int (0 = keine)

field.doc: 🧱 Area of the longitudinal reinforcement between the tension and the compression layer (side and web bars), counted with both end layers in the total longitudinal ratio rho_tot of the cyclic shear capacity (EN 1998-3 A.3.3); 0 = none.
